newsitem.title: UK: Goldsmiths to place new shares at 370p/shr.
newsitem.headline: Goldsmiths to place new shares at 370p/shr.

text.p: British jewellery company Goldsmiths Group Plc said on Thursday it would raise 4.05 million stg by placing about 1.1 million new ordinary shares at 370 pence per share.
The shares, representing about five percent of the current issued share capital, will be placed with instititutional investors, the company said in a statement.
Dealings in the new shares would commence on January 17.
Goldsmiths would use the money to open 15 branches this year and further improve its distribution facilities.
The company's shares were quoted at around 381-1/2p at 1218 GMT.
